card: This pull request removes redundant nested JSON quotes from block hash arguments in the bitcoin-cli help examples for gettxoutsetinfo and getblockstats. Following earlier changes allowing unquoted string arguments, the help examples still displayed nested quotes ('"<hash>"'), presenting unnecessarily complex usage patterns to CLI users. The change is a minor documentation cleanup motivated by feedback on PR #33230, carrying no functional changes or dependencies.
evidence: Author description notes this is a follow-up to PR #33230 based on review feedback pointing out that CLI help examples still contained unnecessary nested quoting
problem: Following changes in PR #33230 that allowed CLI arguments to accept either JSON or plain strings, the help text examples for gettxoutsetinfo and getblockstats still showed cumbersome nested quoting syntax ('"<hash>"'). Users consulting the RPC help output see overly complex examples that suggest nested quotes are required.
scope_notes: Trivial two-line documentation change in RPC help strings.
summary: Removes nested JSON quoting from block hash string arguments in the CLI help examples for gettxoutsetinfo and getblockstats. The examples in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp are updated to show plain block hash strings instead of JSON-encoded strings wrapped in quotes.
